newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Anhui Expressway public offer over-subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Anhui Expressway public offer over-subscribed.

text.p: Anhui Expressway Company Ltd said on Thursday its public offer of 73.95 million H-shares in Hong Kong at HK$1.77 per share had received subscriptions totalling 76.66 million shares.
The company offered a total 493.01 million H-shares, of which 419.06 million were placed with institutional investors.
Dealing in the shares on the Hong Kong bourse begins on November 13, the company said in a statement.
Anhui is involved in highway infrastructure and it owns Hening Expressway connecting Nanjing, in Jiangsu province, and Hefei, in Anhui province.
The offering has raised HK$831 million.
Part of the sum would be used to buy the Tianchang section of National Highway 205, and the rest to buy and install a new toll collection system for the Hening Expressway.
The money would also be used to repay loans, upgrade traffic monitoring system and reconstruct soft ground sections of the Hening Expressway, it said.
